view.scene_description: A modern bookstore or library interior with wooden bookshelves filled with books. A person in a white jacket sits at a desk near a window, working on a laptop. The space features warm lighting, decorative circular lights, and a curved wooden platform. Large windows let in natural light, and green plants add a touch of nature.

objects.label: person
objects.observation: A person wearing a white hooded jacket is seated at a desk, facing left, focused on a laptop. They are partially obscured by a large green plant behind them. Their posture suggests concentration. The desk surface is visible beneath their hands.

objects.label: laptop
objects.observation: An open laptop rests on the desk in front of the person. Its screen is visible but indistinct. The keyboard and trackpad are partially visible. It is positioned directly on the desk surface, supported by the desk’s flat plane.

objects.label: bookshelf
objects.observation: A tall wooden bookshelf with multiple shelves, filled with books of various sizes and colors. It occupies the central background area. The shelves are illuminated from within, casting a warm glow. It stands independently against the wall.

objects.label: window
objects.observation: A large window on the left side of the frame, allowing bright natural light to enter. Trees and foliage are visible outside. The window frame is dark, contrasting with the bright exterior. It is mounted in the wall and provides a view to the outdoors.

objects.label: plant
objects.observation: A large green leafy plant, possibly a Monstera, positioned between the person and the bookshelf. Its leaves are broad and vibrant. It is potted and placed on the floor, standing upright next to the desk.

objects.label: desk
objects.observation: A dark-colored desk surface where the person is seated. It extends horizontally across the lower-left portion of the frame. The laptop and some papers are placed on it. It is supported by unseen legs or structure.

objects.label: chair
objects.observation: A chair with a dark frame and light-colored seat, occupied by the person. It is positioned under the desk, supporting the person’s weight. The backrest is partially visible behind the person’s shoulders.

objects.label: light fixture
objects.observation: Circular, recessed lighting fixtures embedded in the ceiling above the bookshelf. They emit a warm, yellowish glow. One is directly above the bookshelf, another is visible further back. They are mounted to the ceiling and illuminate the shelves below.

objects.label: curved platform
objects.observation: A raised, curved wooden platform extending from the bookshelf toward the right side of the room. It has a glowing underside, suggesting LED lighting. It appears to be part of the architectural design, possibly for seating or display.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_agtea_test50/image-000012", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
